replay_procedure.step_1_build: Use an existing build_qwen4exp_probe (or reconfigure a fresh Release dir with -DESE_QWEN4EXP_PROBE_GATE=ON -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DGGML_EXPERT_CHUNKING=OFF). Never touch build_cuda_release's fail-closed default.
replay_procedure.step_2_opt_in: Set ESE_QWEN4EXP_PROBE_GATE=1 only in the environment of the single diagnostic invocation. It must not appear in any normal launch path.
replay_procedure.step_3_ese_invocation: Run build_qwen4exp_probe/bin/llama-cli with the shared shard paths read-only, -c 131072, q8_0 K/V, devices 0 and 2, logical batch 1024, ubatch 128, PLE async row streaming, MTP disabled (unsupported), and pass raw token ID 12675 as the prompt with 128 greedy outputs. The exact argv used in the 2026-10-04 run was not preserved verbatim; reconstruct from the settings above and record it durably this time.
replay_procedure.step_4_strata_invocation: Recreate the text-only Strata config by removing the vision block from strata-coder-iq1_m.json, keep gpu [0,2], STRATA_SPLIT_OWN=1, then drive GEN 128 12675 through serve/server.py or the engine line protocol.
replay_procedure.step_5_output: Write stdout/stderr and any plan JSON to a durable in-repo path (e.g. docs/qwen4exp/ or a bench/downloads dir), not /tmp. Hash and record them, and update this manifest with the new digests.
replay_procedure.step_6_compare: Compare only like-for-like fields. Do not compare prefill from a one-token prompt. Re-state that these are diagnostic, not parity-qualified numbers.

known_non_parity_limits: No whole-model logits/routes parity exists for the ESE Qwen graph.
ESE has no MTP/speculative path in this probe.
ESE has no bounded GPU-resident QSA KV window (Strata: 32768 cells).
ESE required ubatch 128 because ubatch 1024 failed allocation; Strata used a 1024 prefill chunk.
ESE probe did not enable Strata's per-layer GPU expert cache.
Prompt paths/templates differed; raw token ID 12675 was passed directly to sidestep the template.
